subject: Vendor setup intake & PO readiness — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Northbridge Systems <vendor-ops@northbridge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: vendor intake & PO readiness (Northbridge Systems)

Hi Alice / Northbridge team,

Welcome — excited to get Northbridge set up in our procurement system so we can proceed with the pilot deployment. To keep the kickoff tight, attached is a short intake spreadsheet that lists the items we typically need from vendors and the items our finance/proc team will provide. Can you please confirm which items you can return by EOD Friday (3/20)?

What we need from you (attachments indicated):
- Completed vendor questionnaire (attached: vendor_questionnaire.xlsx) — basic company info and remittance details
- Signed W9 (if US) or W-8BEN (if outside US) — we received a scanned W9 from your finance team earlier but need the signed PDF back for records
- Primary contact for invoices and escalation (name, email, phone)
- Sample invoice PDF (to validate remit fields)

What you can expect from us:
- Standard Redwood PO template (attached) and instructions for PO submission
- Net30 standard terms (unless procurement and legal negotiate different)
- Initial PO created once your account is set up in Coupa/our ERP — we will notify you of the vendor ID and PO number

Two quick asks: 1) return the questionnaire + W9 by Friday; 2) confirm whether you have preferred PO/EDI instructions or a standalone invoice workflow.

Attachments: vendor_questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_PO_template.docx (doc)

Thanks — I’ll loop in finance for the PO creation step once we have the forms.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Programs | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Kim <alice.kim@northbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vendor intake & PO readiness (Northbridge Systems)

Thanks Alice — appreciate the quick turnaround and attachments. A few internal notes and actions so we stay on the same page: 

Internal (Marissa / Neha): please confirm vendor tax form is complete and legible, then proceed with vendor creation in Coupa.

To Northbridge (Alice):
- Bank verification: Redwood prefers a bank letter or an ACH test; if you can provide a bank letter stamped by the bank that is typically sufficient for initial setup. If you prefer ACH micro-deposit, our finance team will send instructions — either method is fine but we need one for compliance.
- Coupa: We provision vendor records centrally. Please do NOT register in the portal — our finance ops will create the vendor ID and send a registration link if necessary.
- PO terms: Our standard is Net30. If you require earlier payment windows tied to milestone invoices, flag that now and we can route to procurement/legal.

Next steps and owners:
- Marissa: confirm W9 legibility and upload all docs to the vendor intake folder (PROC-324).
- Neha (Finance Ops): start vendor record creation in Coupa and flag if we need any further evidence (bank letter).
- Alice: please confirm whether you'll provide bank letter or accept ACH micro-deposit.

Attachments referenced: none

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
---
P.S. Marissa — please use the Redwood_PO_template.docx when drafting the initial PO; that will accelerate matching on their invoices.
